result.summary: Found 1 layout issue where a restaurant title is prematurely clipped despite having sufficient available horizontal space.

issues.description: Under the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped mid-character on the final 'n' ('Tokumaru Rameı'), even though there is ample empty space between the title and the rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Increase the maximum width or flex-grow allocation of the restaurant title container so the full name renders without clipping, and use text-overflow: ellipsis if truncation is genuinely needed for very long names.
